items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: the best snare drum player we had in New Orleans was Louis Contrell... he taught drums.

ctx.x: What kind of stuff did he play? You remember anything?

He was another special. His style of drumming was almost similar to Happy's style. He was a great snare drum player, man, too. He was a great snare drum. And the most drummer, the best snare drum player we had in New Orleans was Louis Contrell.
